note: Rules are matched against the whole build, not against pairs in isolation. Multiplicative axes (offense, aoe, defense) multiply; tracking and evasion take the higher of the current value and the rule's floor, since both are bounded 0-1.

rules.name: Homing lasers
rules.note: A laser that tracks. The charge stops being wasted on a boss that blinks away mid-shot.

rules.name: Homing explosives
rules.note: Blasts that steer themselves land on the target instead of at your feet.

rules.name: Piercing volley
rules.note: Several shots that each pass through a whole line of enemies.

rules.name: Nothing stops it
rules.note: Shots ignore both rocks and bodies, so no angle is a bad angle.

rules.name: Carpet bombing
rules.note: Far more explosions, a good number of them uncomfortably close to you.

rules.name: Familiar swarm
rules.note: A booster is dead weight alone and transformative next to a familiar.

rules.name: Entourage
rules.note: Three familiars aim themselves while you concentrate on dodging.

rules.name: Fast recharge
rules.note: An active you can fire most rooms instead of most floors.

rules.name: Poison line
rules.note: One shot poisons everything it passes through.

rules.name: Orbital ring
rules.note: Enough orbitals to form a shell that blocks shots and grinds anything that touches you.

rules.name: Kill zone
rules.note: Standing next to you becomes the mistake.

rules.name: Unkillable
rules.note: Hits cost less and running out of health costs nothing the first time.

rules.name: Sustain
rules.note: A free hit each room, and the health to absorb the ones that get through.

rules.name: Untouchable
rules.note: Flight ignores the floor and speed outruns what is on it.

rules.name: Glass cannon
rules.note: Everything dies fast, including you. Three damage items and nothing that keeps you alive.

rules.name: Rate and weight
rules.note: Fire rate multiplies damage rather than adding to it, so the two compound.

rules.name: Crowd control
rules.note: Slowed enemies bunch up, and a piercing shot goes through the whole queue.

rules.name: Overwritten
rules.note: Two items both want to replace your tears. One wins outright and the other is mostly wasted.

rules.name: Charging on charging
rules.note: Two charge mechanics fighting each other. Uptime suffers and nothing fires when you need it.

rules.name: Own worst enemy
rules.note: Explosions with nothing to cushion the ones that catch you.

rules.name: Stuck in range
rules.note: A melee build that cannot reposition spends the fight taking hits to give them.

rules.name: No weak axis
rules.note: Damage, bulk and mobility together. Nothing spectacular, nothing to exploit either.

rules.name: One slot
rules.note: You hold one active item. A second means picking which to carry and leaving the other on the floor.

rules.name: Machine gun
rules.note: Enough fire-rate stacking that individual shots stop mattering and uptime does.

rules.name: Bulk
rules.note: Containers stack cleanly. Nothing clever about it, but the Beast has to chew through all of them.

rules.name: Quick
rules.note: Enough movement speed that most patterns become walkable rather than dodgeable.

rules.name: Hands free
rules.note: A familiar keeps damaging things during the pause where you are using something else.

rules.name: Bruiser
rules.note: Hits hard enough to shorten fights and thick enough to survive the ones that run long.

rules.name: Padded
rules.note: Soul hearts absorb what damage reduction has already shrunk.

rules.name: Nothing but damage
rules.note: Two damage items and not one thing that keeps you upright. Fights end fast, one way or the other.

rules.name: Wasted volley
rules.note: A tear replacement does not fire tears, so the extra shots you paid for never happen.

rules.name: Rate you cannot use
rules.note: Fire rate feeds a tear you no longer shoot. The item is close to a blank pick.

rules.name: Charge ignores rate
rules.note: A charged weapon fires when the charge fills, not when the tear timer says so.

rules.name: Already flying
rules.note: Flight does not stack. The second one bought you nothing a pick could have bought instead.

rules.name: Already spectral
rules.note: Shots already pass through walls. Passing through them twice is not a thing.

rules.name: Nothing that kills
rules.note: Five items and not one of them makes anything die faster. Fights run long, and long fights are where runs end.

rules.name: Nothing that saves you
rules.note: No containers, no shield, no mobility. The first mistake is the whole run.

rules.name: Passengers
rules.note: The familiars are doing all the work at their own pace while you plink.
